headline: Bangladesh opens 2027 Hajj pre-registration for pilgrims
summary: The Ministry of Religious Affairs sets conditions for Hajj 2027 pre-registration.
details: Bangladesh has started pre-registration for the 2027 Hajj. The Ministry of Religious Affairs requires prospective pilgrims to provide necessary documents.
Applicants must submit a national identity card, Bangladeshi passport or birth certificate, passport-sized photograph, mobile phone number, and bank account number.
A bank account is compulsory for secure financial transactions. Members of the same family can use a single bank account.
The Saudi government set a deadline of September 26 for Hajj registration.
caption:
Are you planning to perform Hajj in 2027? Pre-registration is now open.

Bangladesh has started pre-registration for the 2027 Hajj. The Ministry of Religious Affairs requires prospective pilgrims to provide necessary documents.

Applicants must submit a national identity card, Bangladeshi passport or birth certificate, passport-sized photograph, mobile phone number, and bank account number.

A bank account is compulsory for secure financial transactions. Members of the same family can use a single bank account.

The Saudi government set a deadline of September 26 for Hajj registration.

headline: 18.7kg of gold: Biman flight from Dubai seized in Chattogram
summary: Law enforcement agencies recovered 160 gold bars wrapped in Scotch tape from the cargo hold of flight BG-138.
details: Law enforcement agencies have seized nearly 19kg of gold bars from a Biman Bangladesh Airlines flight arriving from the UAE.
The contraband was discovered on flight BG-138 from Dubai, according to Dhaka Customs House Additional Commissioner Kamrul Hasan.
A joint team, which included military intelligence, conducted the operation around 10am on Thursday.
The team recovered a total of 160 gold bars wrapped in Scotch tape from the cargo hold of the aircraft.
The total weight of the seized gold bars is 18.7kg.
caption:
Nearly 19kg of gold smuggled into Bangladesh! 160 gold bars were found hidden in the cargo hold of a Biman flight from Dubai.

Law enforcement agencies have seized nearly 19kg of gold bars from a Biman Bangladesh Airlines flight arriving from the UAE.

The contraband was discovered on flight BG-138 from Dubai, according to Dhaka Customs House Additional Commissioner Kamrul Hasan.

A joint team, which included military intelligence, conducted the operation around 10am on Thursday.

The team recovered a total of 160 gold bars wrapped in Scotch tape from the cargo hold of the aircraft.

The total weight of the seized gold bars is 18.7kg.
